audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for Jacob's illness, Joseph's sons, adoption of Ephraim/Manasseh, Rachel memory, crossed hands, younger-over-older blessing, and promise of return.

verses.restored: After these things Joseph was told, Look, your father is sick. He took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

familiar.text: And it came to pass after these things, that one told Joseph, Behold, thy father is sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

verses.restored: Jacob was told, Look, your son Joseph has come to you. Israel strengthened himself and sat up on the bed.

familiar.text: And one told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.

verses.restored: Jacob said to Joseph, El Shaddai appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan and blessed me.

familiar.text: And Jacob said unto Joseph, God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,

verses.restored: He said to me, Look, I will make you fruitful and multiply you, make you an assembly of peoples, and give this land to your seed after you as an everlasting possession.

familiar.text: And said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a multitude of people; and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession.

verses.restored: Now your two sons born to you in Egypt before I came to you in Egypt are mine; Ephraim and Manasseh shall be mine, like Reuben and Simeon.

familiar.text: And now thy two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, are mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.

verses.restored: Your offspring whom you father after them shall be yours; they shall be called by the name of their brothers in their inheritance.

familiar.text: And thy issue, which thou begettest after them, shall be thine, and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.

verses.restored: As for me, when I came from Paddan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan on the way, while there was still some distance to Ephrath, and I buried her there on the way to Ephrath, that is Bethlehem.

familiar.text: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet there was but a little way to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same is Bethlehem.

verses.restored: Israel saw Joseph’s sons and said, Who are these?

familiar.text: And Israel beheld Joseph’s sons, and said, Who are these?

verses.restored: Joseph said to his father, They are my sons whom the Divine has given me here. He said, Please bring them to me, and I will bless them.

familiar.text: And Joseph said unto his father, They are my sons, whom God hath given me in this place. And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.

verses.restored: Israel’s eyes were heavy from age; he could not see. Joseph brought them near to him, and he kissed them and embraced them.

familiar.text: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.

verses.restored: Israel said to Joseph, I had not thought to see your face, and look, the Divine has also shown me your seed.

familiar.text: And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath shewed me also thy seed.

verses.restored: Joseph brought them out from between his knees and bowed with his face to the earth.

familiar.text: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.

verses.restored: Joseph took both of them, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right, and brought them near.

familiar.text: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them near unto him.

verses.restored: Israel stretched out his right hand and placed it on Ephraim’s head, though he was the younger, and his left hand on Manasseh’s head, crossing his hands, though Manasseh was the firstborn.

familiar.text: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh was the firstborn.

verses.restored: He blessed Joseph and said, The Divine before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the Divine who has shepherded me all my life to this day,

familiar.text: And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day,

verses.restored: the messenger who redeemed me from all evil, bless the boys. Let my name be called upon them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac, and let them multiply like fish into abundance in the midst of the earth.

familiar.text: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.

verses.restored: Joseph saw that his father placed his right hand on Ephraim’s head, and it was evil in his eyes. He took his father’s hand to remove it from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s head.

familiar.text: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head unto Manasseh’s head.

verses.restored: Joseph said to his father, Not so, my father, for this one is the firstborn; put your right hand on his head.

familiar.text: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father: for this is the firstborn; put thy right hand upon his head.

verses.restored: His father refused and said, I know, my son, I know. He too shall become a people, and he too shall be great; nevertheless his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become the fullness of nations.

familiar.text: And his father refused, and said, I know it, my son, I know it: he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.

verses.restored: He blessed them that day, saying, By you Israel shall bless, saying, May the Divine make you like Ephraim and like Manasseh. So he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

familiar.text: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee shall Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

verses.restored: Israel said to Joseph, Look, I am dying, but the Divine will be with you and return you to the land of your fathers.

familiar.text: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.

verses.restored: I give you one shoulder/portion above your brothers, which I took from the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.

familiar.text: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.
